Title: Aditya and the Family

Cast

1. Aditya - 8 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Kavya - 13 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
3. Pallavi - 34 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches
4. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Aditya stands in the living room. Pallavi and Kavya stand near him.]

Pallavi: "Today feels like a good day."

[Aditya reads a storybook.]

Aditya: "Hmm, I see."

[Aditya writes in his notebook.]

Kavya (gently): "That's great!"

[Aditya types on his laptop.]

Aditya: "Careful!"

[Aditya watches cartoons on TV.]

Pallavi: "Aditya, are you okay?"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Pallavi and Kavya stand near him.]

Pallavi: "Let's begin."

[Aditya jumps with joy.]

Kavya: "And then?"

[Aditya claps his hands.]

Aditya: "And then?"

[Aditya bursts out laughing.]

Pallavi: "Yes, of course."

Scene 3: The park - Day

[Aditya stands in the park. Kavya and Pallavi stand near him.]

Aditya: "So, here we are!"

[Aditya plays cricket in the park.]

Aditya: "Kavya, look at this."

[Aditya feeds the birds.]

Aditya: "I'm ready!"

[Aditya does push-ups.]

Pallavi: "Yes, all right."

[Kavya skips rope.]

Pallavi: "Kavya, are you okay?"

Scene 4: The terrace - Day

[Aditya stands on the terrace. Pallavi stands near him.]

Pallavi: "Aditya, look over here."

[Aditya flies a kite on the terrace.]

Aditya (laughing): "What a day to remember!"
